description: This file implements certificate compression and decompression logic for QUIC protocol, including handling of certificate chains, zlib compression with custom dictionaries, and certificate hash matching.

classes.name: ScopedZLib
classes.description: Manages automatic cleanup of zlib inflate/deflate streams.

methods.name: CertCompressor::CompressChain
methods.description: Compresses a chain of certificates into a zlib compressed format with a custom dictionary.

methods.name: CertCompressor::DecompressChain
methods.description: Decompresses a zlib compressed certificate chain back into individual certificates.
